verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS platform that ships web and mobile SDKs, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented setting to disable telemetry or usage tracking. Webhook attribute blocklists and IP allowlisting are related controls, not telemetry opt-outs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
